provenance.section: Protocol — "New message types can be added at any time. Clients are expected to ignore messages they do not support."
modifications: events[0].type changed to "backfill", a value the documentation does not list. Not a claim that Coinbase sends it: it is the venue's own statement that new types appear, tested against this repository's rule that a client may not *silently* ignore what it does not support (§8.3).

expectation: Parses. The trades are still normalized — data that arrived is not discarded because its wrapper is unfamiliar. Emits a COINBASE_UNKNOWN_EVENT_TYPE anomaly. Critically, the frame is NOT treated as a snapshot, so it cannot close an open gap: only a documented "snapshot" can do that.
